identity.insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
identity.eligibility_criteria: Indian residents aged 18 to 65 years. Lifelong renewability guaranteed.
identity.renewal_terms: Guaranteed lifelong renewal without exit age. 30 days grace period for annual renewals.
identity.portability_conditions: Portability allowed as per IRDAI health regulations with minimum 45 days prior notice.
identity.geographic_availability: Pan-India coverage across all network hospitals.

coverage.inpatient_hospitalization: Covered up to Sum Insured for room boarding, nursing, surgeon, anesthesiologist, and medical specialist expenses.
coverage.daycare_procedures: All daycare procedures covered where technological advances do not necessitate 24-hour hospitalization.
coverage.domiciliary_hospitalization: Covered for medical treatment exceeding 3 days when patient cannot be moved to hospital.
coverage.home_healthcare: Covered for specified treatment procedures administered at home up to sub-limits.
coverage.ayush_treatment: Inpatient treatment covered in government-recognized AYUSH hospitals up to 100% of Sum Insured.
coverage.ambulance_cover: Road ambulance charges up to ₹2,000 per hospitalization. Air ambulance up to ₹2,50,000 per policy year (for SI ₹5L+).
coverage.organ_donor_expenses: Covered up to Sum Insured for complications arising during harvesting of organ.
coverage.modern_treatments: Covered up to 50% of Sum Insured for robotic surgeries, deep brain stimulation, and stem cell therapy.
coverage.maternity_cover: Covered after 24 months continuous coverage: normal delivery up to ₹50,000, cesarean up to ₹1,00,000. Newborn cover from day 1.
coverage.opd_dental_vision: Outpatient consultations, dental, and ophthalmic treatment covered up to specified limits after 3 years.
coverage.restoration_benefit: 100% automatic restoration of Sum Insured available once per policy year upon partial or full exhaustion.
coverage.cumulative_bonus: Cumulative bonus of 50% for 1st claim-free year, 100% for 2nd claim-free year (maximum 100% of SI).
coverage.wellness_benefits: Star Wellness Program offers premium discounts up to 10% through healthy lifestyle tracking points.
coverage.critical_illness_rider: Second medical opinion included; optional accidental death and permanent total disability cover included.

permanent_exclusions: Weight control and bariatric treatment without severe medical indication
Alcohol, drug addiction and substance abuse rehabilitation
Self-inflicted injuries or attempt to commit suicide
War, nuclear perils, participation in hazardous adventure sports
Experimental, investigational and unproven medical interventions
restrictions.room_rent_capping: No Room Rent Capping for Sum Insured ₹5 Lakh and above (Single Private AC room allowed). Zero proportionate deduction.
restrictions.icu_sub_limit: No Sub-limit on ICU charges (Actuals up to Sum Insured).

disease_sub_limits.Cataract: Up to ₹25,000 to ₹40,000 per eye depending on Sum Insured
disease_sub_limits.Bariatric Surgery: Covered up to ₹2,50,000 to ₹5,00,000 after 36 months waiting period

restrictions.zone_based_restrictions: No zone-based restrictions or co-payment deductions across pan-India hospitals.
restrictions.pre_authorization_rules: Planned hospitalizations require cashless pre-authorization 48 hours prior; emergency within 24 hours of admission.
restrictions.medical_necessity_clause: Treatment must be prescribed by a registered medical practitioner and conform to standard accepted medical protocols.
restrictions.non_payable_items: Consumables excluded unless optional Star Extra Protect add-on is opted.

premium.pricing_factors: Age of oldest member, sum insured tier, floater size, and multi-year tenure discounts.
premium.tenure_discounts: 10% discount on 2-year tenure; 11.25% discount on 3-year tenure.
premium.installment_options: Annual, Half-yearly, and Quarterly premium installment facilities available.
premium.tax_benefits: Deduction up to ₹25,000 under Section 80D (₹50,000 for senior citizens).
premium.medical_underwriting: Pre-acceptance medical screening required for applicants aged 50+ or with disclosed pre-existing conditions.
premium.cancellation_refund_terms: Full premium refund minus stamp duty and medical test charges during 15-day free-look period.
optional_riders: Star Extra Protect Add-on (Consumables, Enhanced NCB, Room Rent upgrade)

claims.cashless_claim_procedure: Present Star Health ID card at network hospital cashless counter -> Hospital raises pre-auth -> Instant approval or within 2 hours -> Cashless discharge upon final claim bill.
claims.reimbursement_claim_procedure: Submit duly completed claim form, original final hospital bill, discharge card, and diagnostic reports within 30 days of discharge.
required_claim_documents: Duly completed Star Health Claim Form
Original Discharge Summary with doctor's clinical history notes
Original numbered hospital final bill with break-up and receipt
Diagnostic reports (pathology, radiology, ECG) with prescription receipts
Doctor's prescriptions for medicines purchased and medical reports
KYC documents and cancelled cheque of proposer
claims.grievance_redressal_details: Toll-Free: 1800-425-2255 / 1800-102-4477 | Email: grievances@starhealth.in | Escalation to IRDAI Bima Bharosa & Insurance Ombudsman.
claims.tpa_support: In-House Claims Administration (Direct settlement with no third-party TPA intervention).

governing_regulations: IRDAI Master Circular on Operations and Allied Matters 2024
IRDAI Guidelines on Standardization of General Terms and Exclusions
